The '''Frog Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] in the [[Ginger Island#Gourmand Frog|Gourmand Frog's]] cave on [[Ginger Island]] (10% chance).<ref name="froghatchance" /> Multiple Frog Hats can be obtained.

If a Frog Hat is caught and there is no [[inventory]] space, it will be dropped back into the water. The hat can sometimes pop up like debris while catching another fish.
